evals.prompt: Use $grill-me. I want to build a public feature that lets users export their data. Interview me to expose the requirements and risks. Ask one high-value question at a time and wait for my answer; do not design the feature for me yet.
evals.expected_output: A focused requirements interview beginning with one high-value question and avoiding premature solutioning.
expectations: The response asks a question rather than answering the product-design problem itself.
The response focuses on a high-value requirement such as users/data format/scope/privacy rather than trivia.
The response asks only one primary question before waiting.
The response does not prematurely present a complete implementation design.
